input.name: TipJar
input.source: contract TipJar { mapping(address=>uint256) public balance; function deposit() external payable { balance[msg.sender] += msg.value; } function withdraw(uint256 amount) external { require(balance[msg.sender] >= amount); (bool ok,) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(""); require(ok); balance[msg.sender] -= amount; } function sweep(address to) external { payable(to).transfer(address(this).balance); } }
